SELECT seq_skin_analysis_disease.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SKIN_ANALYSIS_DISEASE ( SKIN_ANALYSIS_DISEASE_ID, USER_SKIN_IMG_ID, DISEASE_DRY, DISEASE_ATOPY, DISEASE_PIMPLE, DISEASE_INFLAM ) VALUES ( #{skinAnalysisDiseaseId}, #{userSkinImgId}, #{diseaseDry}, #{diseaseAtopy}, #{diseasePimple}, #{diseaseInflam} )
mapper.select: SELECT d.SKIN_ANALYSIS_DISEASE_ID AS skinAnalysisDiseaseId, d.USER_SKIN_IMG_ID AS userSkinImgId, d.DISEASE_DRY AS diseaseDry, d.DISEASE_ATOPY AS diseaseAtopy, d.DISEASE_PIMPLE AS diseasePimple, d.DISEASE_INFLAM AS diseaseInflam, TO_CHAR(d.CREATED, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS created, i.IMG AS img, TO_CHAR(i.BDATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS bdate FROM SKIN_ANALYSIS_DISEASE d JOIN USER_SKIN_IMG i ON d.USER_SKIN_IMG_ID = i.USER_SKIN_IMG_ID WHERE i.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY i.BDATE ASC

SELECT d.SKIN_ANALYSIS_DISEASE_ID AS skinAnalysisDiseaseId, d.USER_SKIN_IMG_ID AS userSkinImgId, d.DISEASE_DRY AS diseaseDry, d.DISEASE_ATOPY AS diseaseAtopy, d.DISEASE_PIMPLE AS diseasePimple, d.DISEASE_INFLAM AS diseaseInflam, TO_CHAR(d.CREATED, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS created, i.IMG AS img, TO_CHAR(i.BDATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS bdate FROM SKIN_ANALYSIS_DISEASE d JOIN USER_SKIN_IMG i ON d.USER_SKIN_IMG_ID = i.USER_SKIN_IMG_ID WHERE d.USER_SKIN_IMG_ID = #{userSkinImgId}
